html: Recently, I've hiked Seven Sisters, flown to Prague twice for the Arb Retreat and the FABRIC alumni reunion (a wonderful joy), attended EAGxOxford (which entailed racing the Vitality 10K in London and immediately commuting to Oxford thereafter), taken the TMUA (for the second time), returned to running, and slept over at Cambridge in a place I definitely wasn't allowed to. Currently, I'm facilitating for Leaf, studying for my Oxford interview, and working on constitutional classifiers for the Impact First residency.
